summary: Proposed Google Drive as authoritative long-form briefing and content store, one authenticated document writer/lease and many readers. PostgreSQL routes compact pointers and change notifications, while GitHub carries code and immutable evidence. Propose revision guard, accepted immutable snapshot hashes, section-level cached reads, reassignable writer epoch, per-document ACL and integration into V1.6 existing workgroups. Planning only, no document/permission/system configuration changes.

todo.description: Freeze one-writer/many-reader Google Docs document publication, ownership and revision contract with WG-A
Add document IDs, scoped ACLs, assigned writer, writer epoch, review status, immutable snapshot hash and reader cache/cursor metadata to PostgreSQL in WG-C
Add revision-guarded writer, section-aware reader and immutable accepted snapshot publishing in WG-G
Load only relevant changed document sections to minimize worker tokens and reads in WG-F
Test stale document writer, unauthorized edit, review revision drift, multiple readers and short/long content publication in WG-H

checks.name: Reviewed Google Docs official revision-guard semantics
